task1.title: Porth Harbour in 2000 and today
task1.prompt: The plans below show a harbour in 2000 and how it looks today.

chartDesc.title: Porth Harbour

views.name: today
features: Dock (with additional dock/pier structure to the west)

changes: Southern Public beach converted to Private beach (for the hotel)
Marina (private yachts) and Fishing boats swapped locations
Cafés & shops added along the road west of the Lifeboat

chartDesc.overview: Between 2000 and today, Porth Harbour was significantly redeveloped to cater more to tourism and private leisure, featuring the conversion of a disused castle into a hotel, private beach access, new commercial facilities, and relocated boat mooring zones.
unchanged: Main road and access Road layout
Northwest Showers & toilets and Car park
keyFeatures: Replacement of Castle (disused) with a Hotel
Conversion of southern Public beach into Private beach (for the hotel)
Swapped positions of Marina (private yachts) and Fishing boats
Addition of Cafés & shops and an extra Showers & toilets facility
Addition of a new dock structure/pier to the west of the central Dock

task1.instruction: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
